description:
Step 2 of fz-kdt.107's cure (cold review 2026-09-01; scope WIDENED by
the fz-kdt.118 refutation). TWO coupled blindnesses at the same layer:

(1) TUPLE TAGS: runtime_type_predicate_tuple_arities (types/mod.rs:2291)
keeps a FiniteSet<usize> of arities and discards sig.elems entirely, so
{:cont,X} and {:halt,Y} are ONE runtime question -- the root of
fz-kdt.104's original miscompile class and of the halt.fz repro. Add
per-position ATOM-TAG discrimination for fixed-arity tuples:
{:cont,_} vs {:halt,_} become different questions, restoring the sound
'narrow test first costs precision, not meaning' reading, dissolving
the tuple class at the predicate rather than by dropping (fz-kdt.118
becomes belt-and-braces). emit_i64_membership/emit_u64_membership
already implement the per-value check live for atoms -- a new test
SITE, not kind; predicate consumed by three backends, measure all.

(2) RECURSIVE ENVELOPE EROSION (from the 118 refutation, probe-proven):
runtime_type_test_envelope erases only TOP-LEVEL funcs
(types/mod.rs:~1519-1525), so {:tag, #66closure} and {:tag, #68closure}
have DIFFERENT envelopes but the SAME RuntimeTypePredicate -- the
104/118 defect verbatim, one tuple deep: with the nested closures
different, the strictly-narrower arm survives as Dispatch{2},
order-decided at a position no runtime test can look at. Per-position
atom tags alone do NOT separate this pair (same atom). The envelope
must erase callables RECURSIVELY (also touches jobs/dispatch.rs:306),
in lockstep with (1) so the envelope and the predicate agree about
what is observable at every depth. Acceptance for (2): the 118
refuter's REFNEST probe shape (same-nested-closure collapses Direct;
different-nested-closure must ALSO drop the contained twin post-fix)
plus the fz-kdt.118 stress knob sweep.

Census note: (1) separates zero in-corpus groups (its value is the
source-reachable halt.fz class); (2)'s reach is measured by re-running
the 118 census helper after recursive erasure.
title: The runtime predicate cannot see a tuple's tag: per-position atom discrimination for fixed-arity tuples
